title: On the asymptotics of the Erdős-Rogers function
summary: The Erdős-Rogers function $f_{\ell,s}(n)$ is the largest order of a $K_\ell$-free induced subgraph guaranteed to exist in every $K_s$-free graph on $n$ vertices. While this function is well understood for $s=\ell+1$, the case where $s$ is much larger than $\ell$ has remained wide open. A long-standing lower bound of Sudakov states that $f_{\ell,s}(n)\geq n^{\frac{\ell}{2s}+O_\ell(s^{-2})}$, while a recent result of Bradač shows that $f_{\ell,s}(n)\leq n^{\frac{\ell-1}{s-1}+o(1)}$.
